questions.prompt: What should an effect key normally represent?
questions.explanation: Keys connect resource or work identity to cancellation and relaunch.

questions.prompt: LaunchedEffect(Unit) runs once for the whole application installation.
questions.explanation: It runs once per entering composition instance and can run again after leaving and re-entering.

questions.prompt: Which API suits showSnackbar from a button click?
questions.explanation: The user event launches a UI-owned suspending operation in a scope cancelled with that UI.

questions.prompt: Changing a LaunchedEffect key cancels and replaces its coroutine.
questions.explanation: Key identity defines when lifecycle-bound coroutine work restarts.

questions.prompt: Which API fits listener registration with cleanup?
questions.explanation: It pairs keyed setup with mandatory cleanup when identity changes or composition leaves.

questions.prompt: SideEffect runs even for an abandoned unsuccessful composition.
questions.explanation: It publishes only after a successful composition is committed.

questions.prompt: Which API supports Flow operators over a LazyListState read?
questions.explanation: It records snapshot reads and emits their changed values to a Flow collector.

questions.prompt: derivedStateOf is useful for every inexpensive string concatenation.
questions.explanation: It helps when the result changes less often than inputs, not as a default derived-value wrapper.
